claims.statement: The EU HFC quota system is designed to steeply reduce volumes placed on the market toward phase-out in 2050.
The regulation extends recovery obligations and emphasizes recycling, reclamation and destruction.

economics.acquisition_route: Seed supply through reclaimers, then aggregate demand through HVAC wholesalers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 100m PLN cross-border annual volume at a 5% fee could yield 5m PLN revenue and a founder stake above 5m PLN in years 6-8
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 70-85% if the platform never owns inventory
economics.payback: Unvalidated: 12-18 months at 3m PLN annual gross merchandise value
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 4-8% transaction fee plus 500 PLN annual buyer membership
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeat purchases follow servicing cycles and quota-driven sourcing plans

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Lot-level price, purity and fulfillment history becomes proprietary market infrastructure
fingerprint.customer: HVAC service companies, refrigerant distributors and industrial cooling operators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: HVAC wholesalers, recovery contractors and service-company purchasing groups
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Verified-lot listings, lab-document vault, forward reservations and logistics coordination without taking title initially
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Buyer pays per fulfilled kilogram; supplier pays a small settlement commission
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A service plan faces constrained virgin HFC supply or cannot evidence reclaimed-gas provenance

founder_fit: Capital-light agency model fits the budget
risks: Incumbent distributors may bundle this service

structure.control_point: trusted inventory and chain-of-custody record for reclaimed refrigerant
structure.critical_dependency: Suppliers must produce legally marketable, correctly labelled reclaimed material at useful volume

thesis: Create a Poland-first exchange where documented reclaimers offer tested refrigerant lots and HVAC firms reserve future supply with chain-of-custody evidence.
title: Reclaimed Refrigerant Lot Exchange
uncertainties: Tradable Polish supply and buyer demand are unvalidated
Lot sizes and gross merchandise value are unknown
